Overview.Name: Peddireddy Indira Priyadarshini
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried + cooked vegetables
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_4 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd

Notes_and_Tips: Do not skip meals as it can trigger migraines.
Keep meals at consistent times daily.
Avoid fried and very spicy foods as they may trigger headaches.
Start meals with protein before eating rice to control portions.
Maintain good posture and light activity to support back pain recovery.
